column2: LASER target string -> resolution override. Two visibly separate classes:
kind=status   a JUDGEMENT about whether the string names a scoreable product
at all. This is where the user's "remove those that dont name a
specific output product" filter is implemented, so every row is
reviewable in one place. Allowed values: biomass, class_noun,
kind=name     a pure LEXICON entry: the MetaNetX name this LASER string means.
No judgement -- anyone can check it by resolving `value`. The
builder re-resolves every one of these and fails if it stops
matching, so the table cannot rot.
The builder also fails on any row whose `token` no longer appears in the
extraction, so a stale override is loud rather than silent.
